top_deficiency_types.title: Keep aisles, corridors, and exits free of obstruction in case of emergency.
Add doors in an exit area that do not require the use of a key from the exit side unless in case of special locking arrangements.
Provide exit doors that are held open by devices that will automatically close on the activation of a fire alarm or smoke detector.
Have restrictions on the use of portable space heaters.
Have generator or other power source capable of supplying service within 10 seconds.
top_deficiency_types.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Honor the resident's right to a dignified existence, self-determination, communication, and to exercise his or her rights.
Notify each resident of certain balances and convey resident funds upon discharge, eviction, or death.
Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide safe and appropriate respiratory care for a resident when needed.
